about_the_game:
Never Immortal

Never Immortal is a 2D multiplayer topdown shooter featuring two different exciting gamemodes: Wave Survival and Zombie Mystery?

Wave Survival (PvE) Can be played alone or with friends

In the Wave Survival gamemode, you need to survive waves of zombies to avoid being eaten alive. You can try to survive as many waves as you can or you can also try to beat the map. You can also buy weapons, ammo, attachments or grenades in the shop. Every 5 waves you fight a boss. They have a lot of health so make sure to replenish your health and ammo! You can also try to get the Weapon Upgrade machine which will allow you to give your weapon special powers.

Zombie Mystery (PvP) Requires a minimum of 3 players, but recommended for 6+ players

In this gamemode you have three roles:

  • Human

  • Zombie

  • Detective

Humans and the detective have to survive or find and eliminate the zombies. Zombies have to eliminate the humans and the detective. The zombies at first glance look like the humans but they can transform into their zombie form which gives them speed but at the cost of being able to shoot bullets which means they have to kill the others by walking through them.  All players can buy weapons and items in the shop, with money which can be earned by playing the objective and winning. The zombies have exclusive items they can use to help them win. The detective does twice as much damage as the other players and also has exclusive items. Humans and detectives must refrain from killing other humans. Players can identify bodies by pressing "Q" by default.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains pixelated blood, bloody pixelated corpses, and depictions of drugs.
